meta.surfaceDefinition: Actions belong only to the named evaluated route, including explicitly labelled third-party routes. Documentation reviewed, not account-tested.

evidenceBasisDefinition.Documentation reviewed: Assessment based on current official documentation, product announcements and public source repositories.
evidenceBasisDefinition.Connected: The route was authenticated and its advertised tools or commands were inspected.
evidenceBasisDefinition.Executed: At least one representative workflow was run against a controlled account or dataset.
evidenceBasisDefinition.Used repeatedly: The route was used across recurring production work, within the stated boundary.

setupDefinition.Easy: Connect a hosted service and approve access. No developer project or custom code.
setupDefinition.Moderate: Requires account configuration, credentials or a small amount of technical setup.
setupDefinition.Hard: Requires developer access, cloud or OAuth configuration, custom integration work or vendor approval.
setupDefinition.Specialist: Requires data engineering, infrastructure or statistical expertise beyond ordinary campaign operations.

actionDefinition.Yes: The evaluated route directly supports the action for its core objects.
actionDefinition.Partial: The action exists, but important objects, fields or workflows are missing or inconsistent.
actionDefinition.No: The evaluated route does not support the action.
actionDefinition.Depends: The action is determined by connected tools, permissions or custom configuration.
actionDefinition.N/A: The action is not meaningful for this type of tool.
actionDefinition.Unverified: The vendor has not documented a dependable boundary.

coverageDefinition.End to end: Completes nearly all of the recurring human job through the evaluated route.
coverageDefinition.Most steps: Completes most of the recurring job with a bounded human handoff.
coverageDefinition.Some steps: Handles useful parts of the job but leaves material work elsewhere.
coverageDefinition.Assist only: Supplies context or one narrow output rather than completing the job.
coverageDefinition.Depends: Coverage depends on the tools, data or permissions configured by the operator.
coverageDefinition.Specialist: Completes a specialist modelling or engineering job rather than ordinary campaign operations.

meta.commercialDefinition: Affiliate means a public commission-paying programme. Referral and Partner are shown separately and must not be described as affiliate programmes.

capabilityDefinition.Yes: The evaluated route directly supports the action for its core objects.
capabilityDefinition.Partial: The action exists, but important objects, fields or workflows are missing or inconsistent.
capabilityDefinition.No: The evaluated route does not support the action.
capabilityDefinition.Depends: The action is determined by connected tools, permissions or custom configuration.
capabilityDefinition.N/A: The action is not meaningful for this type of tool.
capabilityDefinition.Unverified: The vendor has not documented a dependable boundary.

reviewStatusDefinition.current: Current primary documentation reviewed; individual action uncertainties remain explicit.
reviewStatusDefinition.pending: Current route details could not be fully verified; previous verified date and grade retained.

wordpress-com.object: Read posts, pages, blocks, settings and site statistics.

setup.note: Enable MCP, connect the ChatGPT plugin or Claude connector and approve site permissions.

coverage.note: Draft, edit, publish and trash posts and pages. Live edits can apply immediately. Free-site access ends 30 November 2026.

wordpress-com.blocker: Live edits can apply immediately. Free-site access ends 30 November 2026.
dailyTasks: Read posts, pages, blocks, settings and site statistics.
Draft, edit, publish and trash posts and pages.

actionScopes.read: Read posts, pages, blocks, settings and site statistics.
actionScopes.create: Posts and pages default to draft.
actionScopes.modify: Whole content or individual blocks, including live content.
actionScopes.delete: Posts/pages move to trash; restoration window is 30 days.

wordpress-com.readSummary: Read posts, pages, blocks, settings and site statistics.
wordpress-com.writeSummary: Draft, edit, publish and trash posts and pages.

wordpress-adapter.surface: WordPress MCP Adapter with exposed abilities
wordpress-adapter.object: Discover and run explicitly exposed WordPress abilities.

setup.note: Install the adapter, expose abilities and configure authenticated access.

coverage.note: Editorial actions depend on additional installed abilities. Installing the adapter alone does not supply a complete editorial workflow.

wordpress-adapter.blocker: Installing the adapter alone does not supply a complete editorial workflow.
dailyTasks: Discover and run explicitly exposed WordPress abilities.
Editorial actions depend on additional installed abilities.

actionScopes.read: Discover and run explicitly exposed WordPress abilities.

wordpress-adapter.readSummary: Discover and run explicitly exposed WordPress abilities.
wordpress-adapter.writeSummary: Editorial actions depend on additional installed abilities.

webflow.object: Read collections, schemas, CMS items and site data.

setup.note: Use the ChatGPT app or Claude connector and authorise the site with OAuth.

coverage.note: Draft, edit, publish, unpublish and delete CMS items. New localised items and site projects remain unavailable; some visual tasks need Designer open.

webflow.blocker: New localised items and site projects remain unavailable; some visual tasks need Designer open.
dailyTasks: Read collections, schemas, CMS items and site data.
Draft, edit, publish, unpublish and delete CMS items.

actionScopes.read: Read collections, schemas, CMS items and site data.
actionScopes.modify: Draft CMS updates and supported design properties.
actionScopes.publish: Explicit CMS item publish and unpublish.

webflow.readSummary: Read collections, schemas, CMS items and site data.
webflow.writeSummary: Draft, edit, publish, unpublish and delete CMS items.

contentful.object: Read entries, models, assets, locales, references and releases.

setup.note: Configure the MCP app per environment, then connect with OAuth.

coverage.note: Manage content, publish assets and schedule supported releases. Configure each environment; CMS publication does not verify the separate live frontend.

contentful.blocker: Configure each environment; CMS publication does not verify the separate live frontend.
dailyTasks: Read entries, models, assets, locales, references and releases.
Manage content, publish assets and schedule supported releases.

actionScopes.read: Read entries, models, assets, locales, references and releases.
actionScopes.publish: Content publication, unpublication and supported scheduled releases.

contentful.readSummary: Read entries, models, assets, locales, references and releases.
contentful.writeSummary: Manage content, publish assets and schedule supported releases.

sanity.object: Query documents, schemas, projects and datasets.

setup.note: Connect the hosted MCP and authorise the relevant account.

coverage.note: Create and edit drafts; publish individual documents. Release scheduling/publication stays outside MCP; liveEdit types bypass drafts.

sanity.blocker: Release scheduling/publication stays outside MCP; liveEdit types bypass drafts.
dailyTasks: Query documents, schemas, projects and datasets.
Create and edit drafts; publish individual documents.

actionScopes.read: Query documents, schemas, projects and datasets.
actionScopes.create: Drafts or release versions; liveEdit types are immediately published.
actionScopes.modify: Patches to drafts and release versions.
actionScopes.delete: Discard drafts/release versions; published-document deletion unverified.
actionScopes.publish: Individual drafts and unpublish; no release scheduling or publication.

sanity.readSummary: Query documents, schemas, projects and datasets.
sanity.writeSummary: Create and edit drafts; publish individual documents.

directus.surface: Built-in MCP on your Directus instance
directus.object: Read items, schemas, relationships, files and automation context.

setup.note: Enable MCP and OAuth on the existing instance; self-hosting needs configuration and restart.

coverage.note: Manage items, files, schemas and configured workflows. Draft/publish semantics follow the project schema; self-hosted OAuth needs server configuration.

directus.blocker: Draft/publish semantics follow the project schema; self-hosted OAuth needs server configuration.
dailyTasks: Read items, schemas, relationships, files and automation context.
Manage items, files, schemas and configured workflows.

actionScopes.read: Read items, schemas, relationships, files and automation context.
actionScopes.create: Items using the project status conventions.
actionScopes.delete: Role permission plus Allow Deletes; off by default.

directus.readSummary: Read items, schemas, relationships, files and automation context.
directus.writeSummary: Manage items, files, schemas and configured workflows.

shopify.surface: Shopify AI Toolkit + authenticated local CLI
shopify.object: Query store pages and other authorised Admin GraphQL data.

setup.note: Install AI Toolkit and Shopify CLI, authenticate the store and explicitly allow mutations.

coverage.note: Create, edit, publish and delete supported pages and articles. A coding-agent plugin still needs local CLI/runtime and scoped store access.

shopify.blocker: A coding-agent plugin still needs local CLI/runtime and scoped store access.
dailyTasks: Query store pages and other authorised Admin GraphQL data.
Create, edit, publish and delete supported pages and articles.

actionScopes.read: Query store pages and other authorised Admin GraphQL data.
actionScopes.create: Pages and articles with publication controls.
actionScopes.modify: Page content, handles, templates and publication settings.
actionScopes.publish: Page status and immediate/scheduled article publication.

shopify.readSummary: Query store pages and other authorised Admin GraphQL data.
shopify.writeSummary: Create, edit, publish and delete supported pages and articles.

woocommerce.object: Read products, orders and order notes.

setup.note: Install MCP Adapter separately; use a WordPress application password and expose the required abilities.

dailyTasks: Read products, orders and order notes.
Create, update and delete products; perform selected order actions.

coverage.note: Create, update and delete products; perform selected order actions. Developer preview. Version 11.3 removes the old endpoint/authentication; draft and publish semantics need checking.

woocommerce.blocker: Developer preview. Version 11.3 removes the old endpoint/authentication; draft and publish semantics need checking.

actionScopes.read: Read products, orders and order notes.
actionScopes.modify: Products plus selected order status and note operations.
actionScopes.publish: Not established by the reviewed sources.

woocommerce.readSummary: Read products, orders and order notes.
woocommerce.writeSummary: Create, update and delete products; perform selected order actions.

bigcommerce.surface: BigCommerce Store Management MCP, early access
bigcommerce.object: Read product content and selected commerce data.

setup.note: Store owner enables beta; connect with OAuth and grant explicit per-store scopes.

dailyTasks: Read product content and selected commerce data.
Create hidden products and edit product copy and SEO fields.

coverage.note: Create hidden products and edit product copy and SEO fields. Early-access merchant MCP, not shopper MCP; no page/blog tools or product publication.

bigcommerce.blocker: Early-access merchant MCP, not shopper MCP; no page/blog tools or product publication.

actionScopes.read: Read product content and selected commerce data.
actionScopes.modify: Product copy, SEO and selected commerce fields.
actionScopes.delete: No deletion tool in the published management inventory.

bigcommerce.readSummary: Read product content and selected commerce data.
bigcommerce.writeSummary: Create hidden products and edit product copy and SEO fields.

adobe-commerce.surface: Adobe Commerce/Magento CMS REST API, custom integration
adobe-commerce.object: Read and search CMS pages and blocks through REST APIs.

setup.note: Build an authenticated API integration and maintain it.

dailyTasks: Read and search CMS pages and blocks through REST APIs.
Create, edit and delete pages/blocks; control page activation.

coverage.note: Create, edit and delete pages/blocks; control page activation. Traditional Commerce/Magento API scope only; custom integration and visual checks remain.

adobe-commerce.blocker: Traditional Commerce/Magento API scope only; custom integration and visual checks remain.

actionScopes.read: Read and search CMS pages and blocks through REST APIs.
actionScopes.create: CMS pages and blocks, including inactive content.
actionScopes.delete: CMS pages and blocks with the required permissions.
actionScopes.publish: is_active changes visibility; no complete editorial approval flow.

adobe-commerce.readSummary: Read and search CMS pages and blocks through REST APIs.
adobe-commerce.writeSummary: Create, edit and delete pages/blocks; control page activation.
